d:
Revisit the sizzling charm of the 90s with “Gup Chup Chup” from the blockbuster film Karan Arjun, now presented in stunning 8K video quality. Featuring the iconic Mamta Kulkarni, this energetic Bollywood hit is beautifully sung by Alka Yagnik and Ila Arun.
Song Credits :
Singer(s) : Ila Arun, Alka Yagnik
Music Director : Rajesh Roshan
Lyricist : Indeevar
Movie Cast & Crew :
Producer : Rakesh Roshan
Director : Rakesh Roshan
